result.summary: Round 2, lens owner_fit: wrote crossreview-owner_fit.json per design §4.6. It has 16 items, one for every (idea, criterion) score of the market and execution lenses, and none of my own lens. I checked every score against the cleaned copies and looked for a source-backed case for a different score. One disagreement: market / 02-sai / competition_gap, 4 -> 3. The score rests on the idea's own unverified claim that shops 'остались без таких инструментов'. 02 has no dated market check (03 and 04 have 'Что на рынке (проверено 2026-09-25)'). Its row in 05 lists no competitors, while the neighbouring clothing rows do. The market analyst's own note says the competitors are 'не названы ни найденными, ни отсутствующими', which is 'не ясно' = 3 on the scale, and 03 got 3 even with a dated check. Fifteen agree. In their notes I also flag two consistency points that do not change scores. First, execution / 02 / build_fit: the Advisor-like flow applies to 02 too, but missing measurements plus the R3 photo obligations still justify 3. Second, execution / 03 / build_fit: R2 is counted as a plus although bar wording was discounted for 02; 4 still holds on the working panel. Leak: I know 02 became the project (folder name, quality-bar) and did not treat it as an argument either way. Self-check: my script found 16/16 items, their_score equal to the round-1 scores, and all disagreement quotes verbatim, with 0 problems. 'npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260925-01 --stage crossreviews' printed only 'E_JSON crossreview-market.json: file is missing or unreadable' (exit=1) and nothing for crossreview-owner_fit.json. The full-stage check waits for ORCH.
